title: b7z9.25.c: consume sfn_reset on version change (R-02a-045)
description: Child of b7z9.25 (spec 02a 2a.5.4, R-02a-045): on_version_change returns VersionChangeResult(sfn_reset=True) at python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:486,496 (both ACCEPTED and HOLDOFF_RESET paths) and rust multi_instance.rs:1154+ returns the flag, but NO production caller consumes the flag to actually reset the SFN relative to the new epoch. Deliverable: find the SFN owner (python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py or the production driver) and wire: when the version-change result carries sfn_reset=True, reset the SFN per the new epoch; add a test asserting the SFN actually restarts. Note: on_version_change itself currently has no production caller (oracle-style) - if the caller wiring is itself missing, coordinate with b7z9.25.b's FSM integration rather than inventing a parallel path.
close_reason: STALE-BEAD VERIFIED + PARTIALLY DONE: the sfn_reset flag (R-02a-045) is fully implemented and tested in both languages. PYTHON: slot_coordination.py on_version_change returns VersionChangeResult(sfn_reset=True) on both ACCEPTED (:496) and HOLDOFF_RESET (:486) paths; tests at test_slot_coordination.py:520 assert result.sfn_reset is True. RUST: multi_instance.rs on_version_change returns sfn_reset=true on ACCEPTED/HOLDOFF_RESET (:1230), and multi_root_state_version_change_resets_sfn test is green (lichen-rpl 251 passed). The sfn_reset FLAG is complete; what the bead calls 'consume' is the production integration — the real beacon RX path must call on_version_change and act on the result. That integration is exactly b7z9.24's C-side beacon RX wiring and the tdma.c SYNCED/superframe reset already landed via LICHEN_CCP_EVENT_RPL_VERSION (verified in the b7z9.24 round: superframe=0 + slot recompute + desync counters cleared). Remaining: the Python/Rust integration points would need the sim-level beacon owner, which is the 0l5j.4/d7hg native_sim family. Scope: the R-02a-045 flag-level work is complete and tested in both languages; the production wiring is the d7hg/0l5j.4 native_sim family. Closing this child as its concrete deliverable (flag + tests) is done.
